text_block_list.name: イナリワン
text_block_list.text:
よう、そこのトレーナーさん、
たい焼きひとつどうだい？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, ran into an old lady in a bind earlier.
Helped her carry some luggage, and as thanks,
she loaded me up with a whole mountain of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
They're delicious, but way too much for one person to eat.
Was just thinkin' I'd hand 'em out to everyone back at the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Did someone just say taiyaki?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Mention food and you show up in a flash!
You're hungry anyway, right?
Go on, eat as much as you like!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mm, then don't mind if I do—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Man, I did say dig in,
but I didn't think you'd wolf down every single one.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... They were just so delicious...
At-At least as an apology...
Umm, would you please take this?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a senjafuda-style sticker? Now ain't that stylish!
This character looks pretty snazzy too, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It was inside some snacks that looked tasty.
I'm already satisfied from eating the snack itself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Th-That sticker!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sorry Inari, hate to ask out of the blue like this,
but could ya part with that sticker?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My little bro collects 'em, ya see,
and this character is the last one he needs to complete the set!
Apparently it's super rare, too...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, ain't that amazin'!
I was just thinkin' of pastin' it in my ledger, but
if that's how it is—sure thing, take it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: R-Really, ya sure...?! I owe ya big time, Inari~~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely pay ya back for this!
For now, take this as an advance payment
or somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Is this a Shiba Inu? Heheh, Japanese dogs really
do soothe the soul. Thanks a bunch, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, who'da thought a taiyaki would turn into
a plushie? Life sure brings some fun surprises.
choice_data_list: It's just like the Straw Millionaire story.
It's just like the Straw Millionaire story!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that the truth! Well, I'm in high spirits, so
guess I'll head back while takin' this little guy on a stroll.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah... Inari-chan... u-uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...I can't... take it anymore...
Let me pamper someone~~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what the?! C-Calm down!
Dammit, here, pet this thing instead, ya hear me!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...F-Fufu, so cute~
Good boy, good boy~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm so sorry!
I haven't been able to visit home lately...
so I haven't seen the children at all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That sounds tough...
Alright, I'll leave this guy with ya.
Just make sure to give him plenty of love!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thank you so much, Inari-chan.
Oh, here, take this in return.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is... a book from the Edo period?!
A-Are you sure I can take somethin' so valuable...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I found it at an old bookstore and bought it
thinking you might like it, Inari-chan.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thanks a million!
This right here's a real treasure!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Man, this is incredible.
It's got illustrations showin' Edo townspeople's culture.
Hot damn, I can't get enough of this!
choice_data_list: That really turned into quite the treasure!

text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me! C-Could you please
let me take a look at that book?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yeah, go right ahead.

*sigh*... What an incredible book...
Um, I know this is very forward of me, but
would you be willing to part with it?

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I'm writing my graduation thesis on the Edo
period right now, and I need as many reference materials as I can find.
So please, I beg of you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Inari One
text_block_list.text: Alright, got it! Take it with ya!

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? Giving me something so valuable...
A-Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, 'cause I know you'll treat it with care.
Fellow Edo lovers gotta stick together—I won't hesitate to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, if it ain't too much trouble,
how about lettin' me read that thesis when you're done?

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Absolutely!
I promise I'll make it a great thesis!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man oh man, what a fun day.
Turns out that whole Straw Millionaire thing
really does happen!
choice_data_list: ...Are you sure you're okay with giving it away?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
'Course I am! Started with helpin' folks and ended
with helpin' folks. For a tale of warm human kindness,
it couldn't have played out any better!
choice_data_list: Just what I'd expect from a true Edokko!
I'm sure it'll come back to you tenfold.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
'Course I am! Started with helpin' folks and ended
with helpin' folks. For a tale of warm human kindness,
it couldn't have played out any better!
choice_data_list: Just what I'd expect from a true Edokko!
I'm sure it'll come back to you tenfold.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Never keep yesterday's cash in your pockets,
that's the true way of an Edokko!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gahah! Sounds good to me.
I bet it'll come back as a whole mountain of taiyaki!
